user.title: Configure Charger Data Recorder
user.description: This integration records each charging session in a CSV file.</br>Fill in the fields below to configure the integration. The fields are self explanatory, but you can find more details in the documentation (click the questionmark).</br></br>A Charge Detail Records (CDR's) session starts when the charger mode matches the charging value.</br> A finished value ends it immediately; </br>otherwise, the optional cable entity keeps it open while connected and ends it when disconnected. </br>If no cable entity or finished value is configured, any non-charging mode ends the session.</br>

data.meter_source: Meter reading entity (a total amount with unit of measure kWh; for example: 1,178.698 kWh)

data_description.charge_point_id: Enter a fixed charger ID or an entity ID.
data_description.identification: Enter a fixed tag or account ID, or an entity ID.
data_description.vehicle_source: Enter a fixed vehicle name or an entity ID.
data_description.odometer_source: Enter a fixed mileage or an entity ID. Leave blank if unavailable.
data_description.meter_source: Select the entity that reports the charger meter reading in kWh.
data_description.cable_sensor: Define the entity that senses when the EV cable is connected.
data_description.cable_active_state: Enter the state value that means the cable is connected.
data_description.mode_sensor: Define the entity that senses when the EV is charging.
data_description.mode_active_state: Enter the state value that means the EV is charging.
data_description.mode_finished_state: Define the value when charging is really finished.
data_description.csv_filename: Use a path relative to the Home Assistant configuration folder. The year and month are added automatically, for example charger_sessions_202611.csv.

error.invalid_filename: Enter a relative path ending in .csv. Absolute paths and '..' are not allowed.
error.cable_active_state_required: Enter the connected cable state or clear the optional cable entity.
error.finished_state_must_differ: The finished mode state must be different from the charging state.
